component: Prime Ministerial sponsorship and strategic review
controlled_rule: The Prime Minister sponsors the policy direction and reviews strategic performance, but routine coordination, reporting and corrective action continue under the delegated chain whether or not the Prime Minister personally chairs a scheduled review
activation_trigger: Cabinet adopts the governance model; applies continuously and whenever a Prime Ministerial review is postponed
operating_cadence: Strategic review at least quarterly or at the next available Cabinet-authorised forum
required_instrument: Recorded Cabinet decision and terms of reference distinguishing sponsorship, strategic review and delegated operations
authority_boundary: No delegation of Cabinet authority or a minister's statutory powers; no requirement that routine administration wait for Prime Ministerial intervention
evidence_requirement: Cabinet minute; approved terms of reference; published annual review calendar and delegation schedule

controlled_rule: Cabinet designates one responsible minister to chair political-level delivery reviews between Prime Ministerial reviews, resolve matters within portfolio authority and sponsor escalations that require Cabinet decision
activation_trigger: On adoption and automatically during any interval between Prime Ministerial reviews or transition in the office of Prime Minister
operating_cadence: Monthly exception review and quarterly strategic preparation
required_instrument: Cabinet minute and ministerial instrument naming the office, delegation scope, deputy or acting arrangement and escalation threshold
authority_boundary: The designated minister coordinates but does not direct independent bodies, states or another minister's statutory discretion and does not become accounting officer
evidence_requirement: Named office-holder or office; written delegation; conflict and recusal rule; transition handover record

controlled_rule: A senior-officials committee chaired by the Chief Secretary to the Government or an expressly authorised equivalent reviews the portfolio, resolves cross-ministry administrative blockages and prepares matters requiring ministerial or Cabinet decision
activation_trigger: On adoption; when a milestone crosses its escalation threshold; or when a political-level review is postponed
operating_cadence: Monthly and additionally on automatic escalation
required_instrument: Approved terms of reference stating membership, quorum, decision record, substitution rule and escalation limits
authority_boundary: Officials coordinate existing functions only; they cannot create policy, appropriations, establishments or statutory authority reserved to ministers, Cabinet, accounting officers, states or independent bodies
evidence_requirement: Approved committee terms; named members and alternates; standing calendar; decision and action register

component: Ministry delivery officers and planning commitments
controlled_rule: Every participating ministry nominates a senior delivery officer and alternate, assigns each accepted milestone to its ministry planning and performance process, and maintains a current recovery action for any off-track commitment
delegated_owner: Named ministry delivery officer and alternate
activation_trigger: Within the period fixed by the Cabinet decision; on any change of office-holder; and when a milestone is accepted or revised
operating_cadence: Monthly ministry review and quarterly portfolio certification
required_instrument: Accounting-officer nomination letters; ministry planning or performance instruction; milestone-owner register; alternate and handover protocol
authority_boundary: Delivery officers monitor and coordinate; accountability, budget control, employment authority and statutory decisions remain with the responsible ministry and competent office-holder
evidence_requirement: Signed nominations; planning extracts showing accepted commitments; current milestone register; succession handover log

component: Secretariat reporting authority with statutory boundary
controlled_rule: The secretariat may issue reporting templates, maintain the portfolio record, require authorised progress returns, test completeness and refer non-compliance through the approved escalation chain; it may not exercise programme or statutory functions
activation_trigger: On establishment or designation of the interim secretariat; whenever an authorised return is due or incomplete
operating_cadence: Continuous register maintenance with monthly exception review and quarterly publication cycle
required_instrument: Cabinet-approved terms of reference; reporting direction; data schedule; records protocol; approved establishment or interim designation
authority_boundary: No takeover of statutory powers, accounting-officer responsibility, vote authority, procurement, grants, personnel decisions, state powers or independent-body functions
evidence_requirement: Written reporting authority; approved templates and data schedule; complete return register; evidence of referrals rather than substituted decisions

controlled_rule: A missed or forecast-missed milestone automatically enters the exception register and advances through the ministry delivery officer, accounting officer, senior-officials committee, designated minister and Cabinet according to pre-approved thresholds without waiting for a quarterly political meeting
activation_trigger: Milestone becomes overdue, is forecast to miss tolerance, lacks required evidence or remains unresolved at the preceding tier
operating_cadence: Event-triggered with status reviewed monthly and reported quarterly
required_instrument: Escalation protocol defining tolerances, tiers, response owner, recovery-plan field, closure evidence and matters reserved to Cabinet
authority_boundary: Escalation compels review and a recorded disposition only; it does not authorise expenditure, waive a gate or substitute for the competent decision-maker
evidence_requirement: Approved protocol; time-stamped exception register; recovery plans; disposition and closure evidence; unresolved-item ageing report

controlled_rule: The authorised quarterly dashboard and exception statement are produced on the reporting calendar even when a ministerial, Task Force or Prime Ministerial meeting is postponed; postponement is disclosed and does not reset the data cut-off or publication obligation
activation_trigger: Quarter-end data cut-off; postponement, cancellation or non-quorate meeting; or failure by an agency to submit a complete return
operating_cadence: Quarterly on a fixed calendar and annual consolidated reporting
required_instrument: Terms of reference; public-reporting protocol; data cut-off, assurance, correction and publication calendar
authority_boundary: Publication is limited to authorised, quality-assured and disclosure-controlled information; it does not create an entitlement or prejudge unresolved statutory, legal or fiscal decisions
evidence_requirement: Published calendar; dashboard and exception statement; late or missing return disclosure; correction log; assurance sign-off

controlled_rule: The governance instruments attach duties to offices rather than individuals and require an acting arrangement, document transfer, decision log and timed re-nomination when the Prime Minister, designated minister, Chief Secretary, accounting officer or delivery officer changes
delegated_owner: Chief Secretary to the Government and each responsible accounting officer
activation_trigger: Change of government, machinery-of-government change, dissolution or reconstitution of the coordinating body, or change in any named office-holder
operating_cadence: Immediate activation with confirmation at the next authorised review
required_instrument: Succession clause in the Cabinet decision and terms of reference; records handover standard; acting and re-nomination protocol; machinery-of-government review rule
authority_boundary: Succession preserves reporting, records and escalation but cannot bind a successor Cabinet to unapproved policy, appropriation or programme continuation
evidence_requirement: Approved succession clause; current office-role map; handover certificate; preserved decision and risk registers; recorded review by successor authority
